contexts.text: A removal from them for the sake of conjunction. Signified, Explained.
That the Lord takes them out from the infestations... Signified, Explained.
They cannot be taken out of Hell, because...
That those in truth and good... were taken out. Signified, Explained.
For to go out of the land of Egypt = to be taken out and delivered from infestations.
They are sometimes taken out (of that dark place) in order that they may serve others for some vile uses.
They are taken out (of the caverns) and sent into them, alternately.
That the Lord has released those who have wanted to be led by Him. Signified, Explained.
